review.summary: A swipe-poll app has a two-sided cold start, and the paying segment (sellers/creators) is unproven against PickFu's vetted panels. The evidence is two forum threads, with no one named and no sign anyone would pay.

items.why: Every route to voters in the record (launch kit, concierge plan) is someone pasting a poll link into a chat or forum, and today that link unfurls as plain text. acceptance: GET /polls/<id> (the poll page) HTML contains og:image and twitter:image meta tags, plus twitter:card=summary_large_image, pointing to a per-poll image route
The per-poll image route returns 200 with content-type image/png, and the PNG is 1200x630
For a 2-option image poll the PNG contains both option images (snapshot test). For a 4-option text poll with a 200-character question it renders without text overflowing the canvas (snapshot test)
An unknown poll id returns a 404 from the image route, and a private poll's image route returns a generic tiebreak card rather than its options
No file under mobile/ changes in the PR, and the web and mobile CI checks pass

items.title: Free Etsy listing photo tester: 2–4 photos in a mock Etsy search grid, then 'let strangers pick'
items.why: The paying buyer in REVENUE.md is an Etsy seller choosing a main photo, and search turns up no free Etsy-specific tool that compares candidates and collects votes, only PickFu (paid, Amazon-focused) and live split testers. Different from the three failed thumbnail-compare-tool builds (#11–#13): one page for one buyer instead of three tool pages in one PR, with the poll handoff reusing the existing
acceptance: /tools/etsy-listing-photo-test returns 200 with a unique <title>, a meta description and an <h1> naming the tool, and appears in /sitemap.xml

Adding 3 local images renders each one as a 1:1-cropped tile inside a mock Etsy search-results grid, next to the others, with no network request carrying the image until the user asks for a poll (Playwright network log)
Clicking 'Let strangers pick' opens the new-poll form with the 3 images as options A–C, and submitting it creates a poll whose page renders all three (Playwright, desktop and 390px phone)
Loading the page fires the visit beacon with path /tools/etsy-listing-photo-test, so its visitors count apart from the SEO-experiment pages
No file under mobile/ changes in the PR, and the web and mobile CI checks pass

items.title: Free YouTube thumbnail tester: 2–4 thumbnails in desktop and phone feed mocks, then a vote
items.why: Creators already search for free pre-publish thumbnail testers with human votes (CollabPals' credit exchange, Touhfa Arena, which is limited to 2 thumbnails over 5 days), and the research shows they pay TubeBuddy for the same decision. tiebreak takes 2–4 options and closes at a vote target. It reuses the Etsy page's grid component, so it's a small second PR, measured on its own path.
acceptance: /tools/youtube-thumbnail-test returns 200 with a unique <title>, a meta description and an <h1> naming the tool, and appears in /sitemap.xml
Adding 2 local images renders each at 16:9 in a desktop home-grid tile and in a phone-feed tile at 390px width (4 preview tiles), entirely client-side
Clicking 'Let strangers pick' opens the new-poll form prefilled with the images as options, and submitting it creates a poll (Playwright, desktop and 390px phone)
Loading the page fires the visit beacon with path /tools/youtube-thumbnail-test
No file under mobile/ changes in the PR, and the web and mobile CI checks pass
